title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
tagline: A brand new day starts now.
overview_en: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
overview_id: Empat tahun setelah peristiwa Spider-Man: No Way Home, Peter Parker sudah tidak ada lagi dan Spider-Man kini berada di puncak kemampuannya dalam menjaga Kota New York tetap aman. Semuanya berjalan dengan baik hingga serangkaian kejahatan yang tidak biasa menyeret Spider-Man ke dalam jaring misteri yang lebih besar dari apa pun yang pernah ia hadapi sebelumnya. Untuk menghadapi apa yang akan datang, Spider-Man tidak hanya harus berada dalam kondisi fisik dan mental terbaiknya, tetapi juga harus siap menghadapi konsekuensi dari masa lalunya!

title: Resident Evil
overview_en: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview_en: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn't just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

title: The Odyssey
overview_en: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
overview_id: Odysseus, raja legendaris Yunani dari Ithaca, memulai perjalanan panjang dan berbahaya untuk pulang setelah Perang Troya, yang mengisahkan perjumpaannya dengan makhluk-makhluk mitologis seperti Cyclops Polyphemus, para Siren, dan penyihir-dewi Circe.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview_en: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Runner
overview_en: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

title: The Fix
overview_en: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Resident Dead
overview_en: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

title: The End of Oak Street
overview_en: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: Don't Leave the Kids Alone
original_title: No dejes a los niños solos
overview_en: A mother moves into a new house with her two children. One night she must leave the siblings home alone. What begins as a blast of carefree play soon turns into a claustrophobic horror story.

title: After Impact
overview_en: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

title: Toy Story 5
overview_en: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
tagline: The movie ACME doesn't want you to see.
overview_en: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

title: Don't Move
overview_en: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one. Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse. Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move. It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

title: Hope
overview_en: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
overview_en: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

title: Onslaught
tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.
overview_en: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview_en: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Obsession
tagline: Be careful who you wish for…
overview_en: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
overview_id: Setelah menghancurkan "One Wish Willow" yang misterius untuk memenangkan hati gebetannya, seorang romantis yang putus asa menemukan dirinya mendapatkan apa yang dia minta tetapi segera menemukan bahwa beberapa keinginan datang dengan harga yang gelap dan menyeramkan.

title: Mutiny
overview_en: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

title: Digger
tagline: A man. A plan. A meltdown.
overview_en: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: The Uprising
overview_en: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

title: Project Hail Mary
overview_en: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

title: Colony
overview_en: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

title: Zip Wire
overview_en: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview_en: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.
overview_id: Berdasarkan novel laris New York Times, Hipotesis Cinta menceritakan Olive, calon Ph.D. yang spontan mencium profesor paling galak di departemennya, Adam Carlsen. Kebutuhan bersama mereka untuk hubungan palsu berubah menjadi eksperimen kecocokan yang mungkin memecahkan masalah cinta.

title: Moana
tagline: The ocean chose her for a reason.
overview_en: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

title: Disclosure Day
overview_en: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.
overview_id: Jika Anda mengetahui bahwa kita tidak sendirian, jika seseorang menunjukkannya kepada Anda, membuktikannya kepada Anda, apakah itu akan membuat Anda takut?

title: Minions & Monsters
overview_en: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

title: Verity
tagline: There is no light where we're going.
overview_en: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

title: Heart of the Beast
overview_en: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview_en: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview_en: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: Backrooms
overview_en: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
overview_id: Setelah pasien seorang terapis menghilang ke dimensi di luar realitas, dia harus menjelajah ke tempat yang tidak dikenal untuk menyelamatkannya.

title: One Last Shot
tagline: One last traitor. One last mission. One last fight.
overview_en: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
tagline: If you're searching for new adventure, "this is the way."
overview_en: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

title: Scary Movie
overview_en: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

title: Ice Cream Man
overview_en: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Supergirl
overview_en: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

title: Buddy
overview_en: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

title: Drawn Together
overview_en: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.
overview_id: Marfil, putri pengusaha Spanyol yang berkuasa, melihat hidupnya berantakan ketika dia diculik dan dilepaskan tanpa penjelasan. Ayahnya merekrut Sebastián Moore sebagai pengawalnya dan, terpaksa menghabiskan setiap menit bersama, ketertarikan tak terelakkan muncul antara mereka di dunia yang tak seperti yang terlihat. Berdasarkan novel karya Mercedes Ron, penulis kisah Culpables.

title: Lion Fist
overview_en: Martial arts fighter Joe goes to prison for four years and takes his wife's blame for a drug bust. After his release, he learns that his son needs expensive surgery because of a life-threatening tumor. Joe's only chance to save him: a brutal all-styles tournament with a $100,000 prize.

title: The Sheep Detectives
overview_en: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
overview_id: Ketika petani mereka yang tercinta ditemukan tewas dalam keadaan misterius, sekawanan domba menyimpulkan bahwa mereka harus memecahkan sendiri pembunuhan itu, meskipun artinya meninggalkan padang mereka untuk pertama kalinya dan menghadapi kenyataan bahwa dunia manusia tidak sesederhana yang terlihat di buku.

title: Rosebush Pruning
tagline: People are roses. Families are rosebushes. Rosebushes need pruning.
overview_en: When an American heir living in a luxurious Spanish villa decides to move in with his girlfriend, his departure triggers a family collapse as his brother uncovers the truth behind their mother's tragic death.

title: Hoppers
overview_en: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.
overview_id: Para ilmuwan telah menemukan cara untuk 'mentransfer' kesadaran manusia ke dalam hewan robot yang menyerupai manusia., Memungkinkan manusia untuk berkomunikasi dengan hewan sebagai hewan. Mabel, seorang pencinta hewan, memanfaatkan kesempatan untuk menggunakan teknologi tersebut. Mengungkap misteri di dunia hewan yang melampaui apa pun yang pernah dia bayangkan.

title: Michael
tagline: Discover the making of a king.
overview_en: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

title: Shelter
overview_en: A man living in self-imposed exile on a remote island rescues a young girl from a violent storm, setting off a chain of events that forces him out of seclusion to protect her from enemies tied to his past.

title: Kung Fu Soccer
tagline: One kick can ignite the world.
overview_en: The "Supreme Invincible Cup" is about to begin, and a host of top teams are about to engage in an unprecedented showdown! But the Kung Fu Women's Soccer Team has been dealt a hellish script right from the start?! Their opponents are all highly skilled, and external pressure is mounting. The schemes on the field are one after another... Can they use their kung fu to turn the tide on the green field?

title: The Florist
overview_en: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: UNABOMBER
tagline: Where brilliance ends, the madness begins.
overview_en: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.
overview_id: Di drama yang terinspirasi kisah nyata ini, jalan Ted Kaczynski dari seorang genius dan objek percobaan di Harvard sampai menjadi Unabomber terkuak saat FBI memburunya.

title: Forgotten Island
overview_en: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

title: Crazy Magical Mexico
overview_en: A man finds the best motivation to secure and save his town: making an independent Mexican film.

title: Facing El Chapo
overview_en: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

title: The Furious
tagline: To save their loved ones, they will fight everyone.
overview_en: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.

title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
overview_en: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview_en: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

title: The Last Sunrise
overview_en: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
overview_id: Berdasarkan novel kesayangan kita, The Last Sunrise menceritakan Ry, mahasiswi dengan penyakit kronis pergi berlibur ke Mallorca bersama ibunya. Saat dia jatuh cinta kepada Julián dan mulai menikmati hidupnya saat ini, penyakitnya makin parah dan rahasia keluarga yang lama terpendam mengungkapkan semuanya sebelum musim panas berakhir.

title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
overview_en: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
overview_en: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

title: Swapped
overview_en: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.
overview_id: Si makhluk hutan kecil dan si burung agung tiba-tiba saling bertukar tubuh, memaksa mereka untuk bekerja sama agar selamat dalam petualangan terliar dalam hidup mereka.

title: Your Heart Will Be Broken
overview_en: High school student Polina is saved from bullying at her new school and makes a deal with the main bully Bars: he must pretend to be her boyfriend and protect her, and she must do everything he says. During this game, the couple develops real feelings, but her family and classmates have reasons to separate the lovers.

title: Primetime
tagline: Are you ready to make television history?
overview_en: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

title: Evil Dead Burn
overview_en: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

title: You+Me - Against the World
tagline: He runs from everything. Except her.
overview_en: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

title: The Runner
tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.
overview_en: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
overview_id: Dalam film triler psikologis The Runner, Maia Marten, seorang pengacara London yang pintar, merasa hidupnya hancur oleh satu telepon pada lari paginya: putranya diculik. Agar putranya kembali, dia harus terus berlari, mematuhi setiap perintah kejam dan tak memercayai siapa pun - tiap detik adalah ujian sejauh apa seorang ibu akan berjuang untuk menyelamatkan anaknya.

title: The Wrecking Crew
tagline: They fight like brothers. They wreck like legends.
overview_en: Estranged half-brothers Jonny and James reunite after their father's mysterious death. As they search for the truth, buried secrets reveal a conspiracy threatening to tear their family apart.
overview_id: Dalam KRU PENGHANCUR, saudara tiri, Jonny dan James, bertemu kembali setelah kematian misterius ayah mereka. Saat mereka mencari kebenaran, rahasia terpendam mengungkap konspirasi untuk menghancurkan keluarga mereka. Berlatar di Hawaii, film ini disutradarai oleh Ángel Manuel Soto dan dibintangi oleh Claes Bang, Jacob Batalon, Stephen Root, dan Morena Baccarin.

title: Khalifa: The Ruler
tagline: Vengeance will be written in gold.
overview_en: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview_en: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

title: War Machine
overview_en: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.
overview_id: Dalam misi terakhir pelatihan Ranger Angkatan Darat yang brutal, seorang insinyur tempur harus memimpin unitnya melawan mesin pembunuh raksasa dari dunia lain.

title: Voicemails for Isabelle
tagline: Sometimes the universe leaves you a message.
overview_en: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.
overview_id: Pengakuan lucu berupa pesan suara dari seorang wanita muda untuk mendiang saudarinya tanpa disadari terkirim ke pria tak dikenal, yang mulai jatuh hati dari kejauhan.

title: Mortal Kombat II
overview_en: The fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview_en: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Lucky Strike
overview_en: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Rage of Stars
overview_en: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

title: Crawlers
overview_en: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

title: Masters of the Universe
overview_en: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

title: Greenland 2: Migration
overview_en: Having found the safety of the Greenland bunker after the comet Clarke decimated the Earth, the Garrity family must now risk everything to embark on a perilous journey across the wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview_en: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: Crime 101
overview_en: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

title: Scream 7
overview_en: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

title: It Ends
overview_en: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
overview_en: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview_en: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: The Whisper Man
tagline: If you leave a door half open, soon you'll hear the whispers spoken.
overview_en: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.
overview_id: Saat putra kecilnya hilang, seorang duda meminta bantuan ayahnya yang lama terpisah, pensiunan detektif yang menangkap pembunuh berantai yang kini terkait kasus itu.

title: In the Grey
tagline: When billions get stolen, meet the pros who steal it back.
overview_en: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

title: The Invite
overview_en: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
original_title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
overview_en: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

title: GOAT
tagline: You're never too small to dream big.
overview_en: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

title: Thrash
tagline: If the flood doesn't kill you...
overview_en: When a catastrophic hurricane slams a coastal town, stranded residents must survive rapidly rising waters swarming with ravenous sharks.
overview_id: Ketika badai dahsyat menghantam sebuah kota pesisir, penduduk yang terdampar harus bertahan hidup di tengah air yang naik dengan cepat dan dipenuhi hiu-hiu ganas.

title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
overview_en: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.
overview_id: Putri muda seorang jurnalis menghilang di padang pasir tanpa jejak—delapan tahun kemudian, keluarga yang hancur itu terkejut ketika ia dikembalikan kepada mereka, dan apa yang seharusnya menjadi reuni yang penuh sukacita berubah menjadi mimpi buruk yang mengerikan.

title: Send Help
tagline: Meet Linda Liddle... She's from strategy and planning. She's the boss now.
overview_en: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

title: The Drama
tagline: Witness the wedding of the year.
overview_en: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

title: Family
tagline: We hurt the ones we love.
overview_en: A 10-year-old girl begins to believe her parents are trying to kill her. Convinced a sinister spirit is to blame, she spirals into a haunting fantasy world that mirrors her deepest fears.

title: Leviticus
overview_en: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most: each other.

title: Kraken
tagline: Only 5% of the ocean has been explored for a reason…
overview_en: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

title: Above & Below
overview_en: A group of friends' dream diving vacation turns into a fight for survival when brutal criminals attack their boat in open waters.

title: Tuner
overview_en: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

title: Cold Storage
overview_en: When a mutating, highly contagious fungus escapes a sealed facility, two employees – joined by a grizzled bioterror operative – must survive the wildest night shift ever to save humanity from extinction.

title: One Night Only
overview_en: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: By Any Means
tagline: The FBI couldn't crack it. So they called in the mob.
overview_en: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview_en: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Soulm8te
tagline: You can't turn off the power of love.
overview_en: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
original_title: Tadeo Jones y La Lámpara Maravillosa
overview_en: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

title: Deep Water
tagline: Surviving the crash is just the beginning.
overview_en: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

title: The Weight
tagline: A tale of good and evil.
overview_en: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: Apex
overview_en: A grieving woman pushing her limits on a solo adventure in the Australian wild is ensnared in a twisted game with a cunning killer who thinks she's prey.
overview_id: Seorang wanita yang berduka nekat bertualang sendirian di alam liar Australia dan terjebak dalam permainan gila dengan pembunuh licik yang menganggapnya sebagai mangsa.

title: Ghost in the Cell
overview_en: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

title: Pretty Lethal
overview_en: A troupe of ballerinas find themselves fighting for survival as they attempt to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.
overview_id: Film triler penuh aksi di mana lima balerina terdampar di hutan terpencil saat sedang menuju kompetisi dansa. Mereka berlindung di penginapan mengerikan yang dikelola Devora Kasimer di tepi jalan dan harus mempersenjatai pelatihan elite mereka untuk bertahan hidup.

title: Mayday
tagline: A friendship with major red flags.
overview_en: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.
overview_id: Saat seorang pilot Angkatan Laut AS dalam misi rahasia selama Perang Dingin terjebak di belakang garis musuh, satu-satunya peluang untuk bertahan hidup adalah menjalin aliansi dengan seorang mantan agen KGB eksentrik.

title: The Secret Woman
overview_en: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

title: Citizen Vigilante
tagline: An action film inspired by real events.
overview_en: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

title: Motor City
overview_en: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

title: Toxic
overview_en: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

title: I Want Your Sex
overview_en: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

title: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
original_title: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
tagline: Time is running out. Are you ready to join the revolution?
overview_en: A 'Man from the Future' arrives at an LA diner where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intelligence.

title: Borderline
overview_en: Convinced they are our secret saviors, rogue U.S. operatives abduct Mexican gang members and seed them across major American cities, unleashing criminal chaos, swaying voters by playing on nativist prejudices, and forcing law enforcement into a race to expose the plot as the escalating carnage threatens democracy itself.

title: The Bride!
tagline: Here comes the mother f*%#ing bride!
overview_en: A lonely Frankenstein travels to 1930s Chicago to ask groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious to create a companion for him. The two revive a murdered young woman and The Bride is born. But what ensues is beyond what either of them imagined.

title: The Dog Stars
tagline: At the end of the world, no one survives alone.
overview_en: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Good Boy
tagline: Some people only learn the hard way.
overview_en: Tommy, a volatile 19-year-old, revels in drugs, parties and violence. After getting separated from his friends on a drunken bender, he is abducted by a shadowy figure. He wakes to find himself imprisoned in the basement of a remote Yorkshire house, inhabited by a very strange family. But what unfolds is not what he could possibly expect.

title: The Odyssey
tagline: The most epic voyage of all time!
overview_en: Based on the Ancient Greek epic. After ten years of war, King Odysseus sets sail for Ithaca, eager to reunite with his beloved. But his journey home is far more treacherous than the battlefield, as he must face deadly monsters and vengeful gods to survive.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview_en: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

title: The Incomer
tagline: Welcome to Auk Isle. Population: one too many.
overview_en: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の海底鬼岩城
overview_en: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
original_title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
overview_en: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.
overview_id: Dalam film baru ini, Jack Ryan terpaksa terjun kembali ke dunia spionase ketika misi rahasia internasional mengungkap konspirasi berbahaya. Sambil berlomba melawan waktu, dia bergabung dengan sekutu CIA Mike November dan James Greer, serta petugas MI6 yang jeli, Emma Marlowe, untuk melawan unit operasi rahasia yang nakal dalam pertarungan yang penuh risiko dan sangat pribadi.

title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
overview_en: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
overview_en: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

title: Haciendo amigos
overview_en: Antonio and Félix, small-time thieves fleeing police after a jewelry heist, meet Eva, a theater group monitor. She mistakes Félix for Ángel, a new member. They use the confusion to hide, unaware they'll spend a week with the group.

title: My Dearest Assassin
original_title: เลือดรักนักฆ่า
overview_en: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

title: The Rip
tagline: Count the money. Count it again. Count on no one.
overview_en: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.
overview_id: Kepercayaan terkikis ketika tim polisi Miami menemukan jutaan dolar uang tunai di rumah penyimpanan kumuh, membuat semua orang—dan semua hal—dipertanyakan.

title: Normal
overview_en: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

title: Return to Silent Hill
tagline: Guilt is a place you can never leave.
overview_en: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.
overview_id: Saat James menerima surat misterius dari mendiang istrinya, Mary, ia terpanggil kembali ke Silent Hill—kota penuh kenangan yang kini ditelan kegelapan. Dalam pencarian tersebut, James harus berhadapan dengan makhluk-makhluk mengerikan. Ia perlahan mengungkap kebenaran kelam yang menyeretnya ke ambang kegilaan.

title: The Last House
overview_en: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.
overview_id: Tiba-tiba terkurung di dalam rumah, keluarga ini harus bekerja sama untuk bertahan hidup saat persediaan makanan menipis dan kekuatan jahat membuat mereka terperangkap.

title: “Wuthering Heights”
overview_en: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
overview_en: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

title: Hot Spot
overview_en: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: The Devil's Mouth
overview_en: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.
overview_id: Lima orang teman menjelajahi sistem gua Devil's Mouth di Thailand untuk satu petualangan terakhir sebelum memasuki dunia kerja. Namun, mereka menemukan suatu makhluk yang memburu mereka di bawah air... Cepat, senyap, dan mematikan. Dalam kegelapan menyesakkan, kepercayaan hancur, kepanikan menyebar, dan tiap kesalahan memaksa mereka berjuang bertahan hidup.

title: Seven Snipers
tagline: She escaped her past. It hunted her down.
overview_en: When a former elite sniper is hunted down by the ruthless warlord who once held her captive, she must fight to the death to protect the daughter she has raised in hiding, on a remote Australian farm.

title: Sense and Sensibility
tagline: No one knows your heart like a sister.
overview_en: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: La bola negra
overview_en: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

title: De Gaulle: Résistance
original_title: La bataille de Gaulle - partie 1 : L'âge de fer
tagline: Some wars are won by armies. Others by those who refuse to surrender.
overview_en: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

title: Balls Up
tagline: Their survival takes a big pair.
overview_en: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.
overview_id: Dalam komedi konyol dan berlebihan ini, eksekutif pemasaran Brad dan Elijah \"berani mati\" dan menawarkan kondom untuk menjadi sponsor Piala Dunia. Setelah perayaan mabuk-mabukan mereka di Brasil memicu skandal di dunia, mereka harus menghindari penggemar yang marah, penjahat, dan pejabat yang haus kekuasaan untuk menyelamatkan karier dan pulang dengan selamat.

title: Until the End of the World
overview_en: Manuel's life is upended when Esmeralda, his lost love from 15 years ago, calls unexpectedly. Despite being set to marry another, he rediscovers Esmeralda, and they realize their love transcends time.

title: THE RIBBON HERO
original_title: THE RIBBON HERO リボンヒーロー
overview_en: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.
overview_id: Saat monster Nergal menghancurkan kerajaannya, Putri Sapphire bangkit sebagai The Ribbon Hero dan berjuang menyelamatkan rumah barunya dari nasib tragis yang sama.

title: Passenger
tagline: 130 million people take road trips every year. 15,400 of them are never seen again.
overview_en: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger that won't stop until it claims them both turns their van life adventure into a nightmare.

title: How to Make a Killing
tagline: $28 billion inheritance. 7 relatives standing in the way.
overview_en: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

title: Outcome
overview_en: Reef Hawk, Hollywood's poster child since age six, is not okay. When he learns about an extortion plot tied to a mysterious video, Reef preemptively sets out on a redemption tour to make amends, confront his demons, and avoid getting canceled.
overview_id: Reef Hawk, anak emas Hollywood sejak usia enam tahun, sedang tidak baik-baik saja. Ketika dia mengetahui adanya rencana pemerasan terkait sebuah video misterius, Reef segera memulai tur penebusan dosa untuk memperbaiki keadaan, menghadapi traumanya, dan menghindari diboikot publik.

title: You, Me & Tuscany
tagline: She came for the pasta and got lost in the sauce.
overview_en: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

title: Desire
overview_en: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

title: Strung
overview_en: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

title: They Will Kill You
overview_en: A woman answers a help wanted ad to be a housekeeper in a mysterious New York City high-rise, unaware that she is entering a community that has seen a number of disappearances over the years and may be under the grip of a Satanic cult.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview_en: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Mercy
tagline: Prove your innocence to an AI judge or face execution.
overview_en: In the near future, a detective stands on trial accused of murdering his wife. He has ninety minutes to prove his innocence to the advanced AI Judge he once championed, before it determines his fate.

title: Colors of Evil: Black
overview_en: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.
overview_id: Saat seorang anak lelaki hilang di kota kecil yang tenang, seorang jaksa yang baru ditugaskan kembali mengungkap hubungan tak terduga dengan kasus lama orang hilang.

title: Hokum
overview_en: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

title: Whistle
overview_en: When a misfit group of unwitting high school students stumbles upon a cursed Aztec Death Whistle, they discover that blowing it unleashes a terrifying sound that summons their future deaths to hunt them down.

title: Over Your Dead Body
tagline: Breakups are all in the execution.
overview_en: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to "reconnect", but each has secret intentions to kill the other.

title: NAZA
tagline: A window into systems of mass killing.
overview_en: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

title: Blue Film
overview_en: Drawn by the promise of easy money and anonymous sex, queer camboy Aaron Eagle is shocked to discover a personal connection with the mysterious stranger who has paid for his company.

title: Untitled Home Invasion Romance
overview_en: As a last-ditch attempt to save his failing marriage, an actor stages a home invasion during a romantic getaway weekend.

title: undertone
overview_en: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way.

title: Signal One
overview_en: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

title: Accidental Partners
overview_en: Two women discover they were both scammed by the same man (who also got them pregnant). They form an alliance to take revenge.

title: Sacrifice
overview_en: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

title: Vengeance
overview_en: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.

title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
original_title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
overview_en: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

title: Black Box
overview_en: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

title: 23 000 Lives
overview_en: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.
overview_id: Sekelompok orang yang masih muda berlayar ke Mediterania untuk menyelamatkan nyawa para pengungsi—misi yang menguji pemikiran mereka tentang hukum dan keadilan.

title: Pressure
tagline: In the hours before D-Day, one decision changed the world.
overview_en: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

title: Tony
tagline: "I was — to be frank — a spoiled, miserable, narcissistic, self-destructive and thoughtless young lout, and badly in need of a good ass-kicking."
overview_en: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: Spa Weekend
overview_en: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: The Bluff
overview_en: When her tranquil life on a remote island is shattered by the return of her vengeful former captain, a skilled ex-pirate must confront her bloody past and unleash her deadly talents to save her family from a ruthless siege.
overview_id: Saat kehidupan tenangnya hancur oleh kembalinya mantan kapten yang pendendam, mantan bajak laut yang terampil harus menghadapi masa lalunya yang penuh darah dan melepaskan bakat mematikannya untuk menyelamatkan keluarganya dari pengepungan kejam.

title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
original_title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview_en: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.
overview_id: Ketika rumah kesayangan Snoopy menghilang, ia mencoba melacaknya, dan menyadari apa yang membuat suatu tempat menjadi rumah.

title: Blades of the Guardians
tagline: A grand martial arts feast is back!
overview_en: Dao Ma, the "second most wanted fugitive," is entrusted by his benefactor, the chief of Mo family clan, to take on a mysterious escort mission-escorting the "most wanted fugitive" to Chang'an.

title: The Mortuary Assistant
overview_en: Rebecca Owens, a recent mortuary science graduate takes a night shift job at River Fields Mortuary. Initially, the job seems straightforward — embalming bodies, completing paperwork, and keeping things tidy. But once Rebecca starts working the night shift, things take a dark turn.

title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
tagline: It will all come to this.
overview_en: After his estranged son gets embroiled in a Nazi plot, self-exiled gangster Tommy Shelby must return to Birmingham to save his family — and his nation.
overview_id: Setelah putranya yang hidup terpisah terlibat rencana Nazi, Tommy Shelby,, gangster yang mengasingkan diri, harus kembali ke Birmingham demi keluarga dan negaranya.

title: Enola Holmes 3
overview_en: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.
overview_id: Petualangan mengikuti detektif Enola Holmes ke Malta. Di sana, rencananya pernikahannya kacau setelah hilangnya Sherlock menjerumuskan Enola ke dalam kasus berbahaya.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
overview_en: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

title: Beast Race
overview_en: In future Rio de Janeiro, a young leader of the resistance must enter a deadly parkour-inspired competition in order to save his sister's life.
overview_id: Demi menyelamatkan saudarinya, pemimpin pemberontak harus mengikuti balapan brutal yang memadukan parkour dengan perkelahian jalanan di Rio de Janeiro yang distopis.

title: Her Private Hell
overview_en: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

title: The Get Out
tagline: The night life is dirty business.
overview_en: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival - where escape may no longer be an option.

title: Beast
tagline: Legends are made in the cage.
overview_en: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in one championship against the brutal champion Xavier Grau.

title: Immortal Combat
tagline: The World's Greatest Warriors...Fight To The Death
overview_en: History's greatest warriors, including Genghis Khan and Joan of Arc, are summoned by a shadowy organization to fight in a battle to the death. But unknown to their captors, the fighters have been plotting to turn the tables and dismantle the deadly enterprise from within.

title: Kill Code
overview_en: North America has been divided into four main quadrants. A power-hungry corporation has taken over the conventional prison system and made criminals the new law enforcers. The owner of that corporation, nanoscientist Eion Prescott, created a nano-virus called Onyx. Which is distributed through deadly watches to criminals. First, infecting them. Then, forcing them into eliminating each other for freedom. Who can topple the corporation's entire system from within?

title: Love Me Love Me
overview_en: After her brother's death, June moves to Milan for a fresh start, finding comfort in Will, the perfect honor student at her new international school. But when his troubled best friend James—hiding a dangerous life in clandestine MMA fights—sparks a rivalry that quickly turns into irresistible attraction, June must choose between safety and a love that upends everything she thought she wanted.
overview_id: Setelah kematian kakaknya, June pindah ke Milan untuk memulai kembali. Ia menaruh hati kepada Will, pelajar teladan di sekolah internasional barunya. Namun, setelah sahabat Will, James-yang terlibat pertarungan MMA rahasia-memicu persaingan yang segera berubah menjadi ketertarikan yang tak terbendung, June harus memilih di antara rasa aman dan cinta yang mengguncang segala yang ia inginkan.

title: Roommates
overview_en: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.
overview_id: Saat Devon, mahasiswi baru yang pemalu, meminta Celeste yang keren jadi teman sekamarnya, persahabatan yang awalnya terjalin segera berubah jadi perang pasif-agresif.

title: The Breadwinner
tagline: One dad. Three kids. Zero clue.
overview_en: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

title: Office Romance
overview_en: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.
overview_id: Jennifer Lopez dan Brett Goldstein membintangi komedi romantis seksi tentang romansa rahasia di kantor dan kekacauan yang dihadapi dua penggila kerja ini karena cinta.

title: Good Vibes Only
overview_en: Based on the true story of a married couple who invented a groundbreaking sex toy heralded as forever changing the way women experience pleasure.

title: Panda Plan: The Magical Tribe
original_title: 熊猫计划之部落奇遇记
overview_en: The panda "Huhu" is about to move into a brand new panda enclosure when he's suddenly confronted by international robbers. Huhu falls off a cliff while battling the robbers, only to awaken to discover he's in a mysterious tribe. To return to the enclosure, this intriguing team helps the tribe solve various problems...
overview_id: Panda bernama Huhu hampir saja menempati kandang barunya yang megah saat kawanan perampok internasional tiba-tiba menyerang. Di tengah pertarungan sengit melawan para perampok tersebut, Huhu terjatuh dari tebing. Ia kemudian terbangun dan menyadari dirinya berada di tengah sebuah suku misterius. Demi bisa kembali pulang ke tempat asalnya, tim unik ini membantu para penduduk suku menyelesaikan berbagai masalah yang mereka hadapi.

title: Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway
original_title: 名探偵コナン ハイウェイの堕天使
tagline: The goddess of the wind vs the fallen angel
overview_en: When a string of deadly highway incidents begin, Conan Edogawa's investigations point towards an orchestrated plot rather than mere accidents. As he uncovers a conspiracy involving hidden identities and advanced technology, the case escalates into a high-speed race against time to stop a calculating mastermind before more lives are lost.

title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
overview_en: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.
overview_id: Dalam drama mengharukan adaptasi novel terlaris ini, seorang janda menjalin ikatan dengan gurita cerdas dan pria muda asing saat bekerja malam di akuarium kota kecil.

title: Fatherland
overview_en: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
tagline: The truth behind a perfect marriage.
overview_en: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

title: The Debt Collector
original_title: คนเดือดทวงแค้น
tagline: A debt can be settled, but not erased.
overview_en: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

title: The Pout-Pout Fish
overview_en: Living on a rundown shipwreck, Mr. Fish one day discovers a hyperactive young sea dragon Pip – who had mistaken his home for a junkyard – pilfering his belongings. The heated argument that ensues leaves both their houses in ruin. But there is hope! Embarking on a seemingly impossible quest in search of the mythical 'Shimmer' to grant them a wish, there’s only one problem: someone else is on the hunt...

title: Ladies First
overview_en: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.
overview_id: Kehidupan seorang playboy arogan, tetapi karismatik, yang penuh uang, kekuasaan, dan kencan iseng berubah total saat ia terbangun di dunia paralel yang didominasi wanita.

title: Primate
overview_en: College student Lucy and her friends spend their vacation at her family's home in Hawaii, which includes her pet chimpanzee, Ben. However, when Ben contracts rabies after being bitten by a rabid animal, the group must fight for their lives in order to avoid the now-violent chimp.

title: Pizza Movie
overview_en: A group of college students go downstairs to their dorm lobby to get a delivery pizza. There's only one issue: They're insanely high on a homemade drug, turning their simple journey down two sets of stairs into a mind-bendingly transformative quest.

title: Master of the Universe
overview_en: A young man must use his untapped powers to fight back against an evil alien and their army, who will stop at nothing to take over Earth and then the universe.

title: Protector
tagline: Never get between a mother and her child.
overview_en: Nikki's life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

title: Dead Man's Wire
overview_en: In 1977, former real estate developer Tony Kiritsis puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.

title: Reminders of Him
overview_en: When Diem's custodial grandparents adamantly refuse Kenna's attempts to see her daughter, Kenna discovers unexpected compassion, and then something truer and deeper, with former NFL player and local bar owner Ledger. As their secret romance develops, so do the dangers for both of them, leading Kenna toward heartbreak and, ultimately, the hope for a second chance.

title: Silent Friend
overview_en: In the heart of a botanical garden in a medieval university town in Germany stands a majestic ginkgo tree. This silent witness has observed over a century the quiet rhythms of transformation across three human lives. At three distinct moments across the 20th and 21st centuries, these people — each carrying their own questions and inner struggles — inevitably find themselves drawn into the presence of this tree, full of mystery and meaning.

title: Little Brother
overview_en: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.
overview_id: Hidup sempurna seorang agen properti yang kaku mengalami perombakan ekstrem saat "adik lelaki"-nya yang kacau, tapi baik hati, tiba-tiba muncul lagi.

title: Kissing Is the Easy Part
overview_en: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
original_title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
overview_en: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

title: Lust Stories 3
overview_en: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

title: Marsupilami
overview_en: David is tasked to deliver a mysterious package from South America, only to find out he is carrying a baby Marsupilami!

title: The Dink
overview_en: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.
overview_id: Dusty “Sang Hammer” Boyd, mantan petenis profesional yang kariernya telah merosot, membutuhkan kemenangan. Demi menyelamatkan klub tenis yang sedang kesulitan dan mendapatkan kembali rasa hormat ayahnya, Dusty melanggar sumpah suci dan melakukan hal yang tak terduga, dia bermain pickleball.

title: Gandhari
overview_en: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: One Mile: Chapter One
overview_en: After being released from special forces, a father tries to reconnect with his daughter by taking her on a tour of college, but they soon find themselves fighting for more than their lost relationship when a murderous cult pursues them.

title: Brothers Under Fire
tagline: He never planned to fight. But he refuses to fall.
overview_en: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

title: The Wizard of the Kremlin
tagline: Power was the plan. Putin was the consequence.
overview_en: In the chaos of post-Soviet Russia, rising KGB officer Vladimir Putin joins forces with master manipulator Vadim Baranov to reshape life behind the Iron Curtain, using violence and deception to change the world forever.

title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
original_title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
overview_en: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.
overview_id: Lihat dari dekat upaya dan keahlian yang tercurah bertahun-tahun di balik season terakhir serial ikonik Duffer Bersaudara yang membentuk generasi ini.

title: Your Fault: London
tagline: How do you hold onto true love after you've found it?
overview_en: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
original_title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
overview_en: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.
overview_id: Sang naturalis kawakan, Sir David Attenborough, menceritakan kisah sekelompok gorila yang luar biasa, sejak pertemuan pertamanya pada tahun '70-an hingga saat ini.

title: Just Play Dead
overview_en: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

title: Mother Mary
tagline: This is not a ghost story.
overview_en: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

title: Saccharine
overview_en: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

title: In the Hand of Dante
overview_en: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

title: The Beloved
overview_en: The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.

title: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
tagline: Elvis sings and tells his story like never before.
overview_en: Long-lost footage from Elvis Presley's legendary Las Vegas residency in the 1970s woven together with rare 16mm footage from Elvis on Tour, and 8mm from the Graceland archive, plus recordings of Elvis telling "his side of the story" rediscovered during Baz Luhrmann's research for his 2022 film, Elvis.

title: 72 HOURS
tagline: The night is young. He isn't.
overview_en: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.
overview_id: Setelah tak sengaja ditambahkan ke obrolan grup pria berusia 20-an, eksekutif periklanan berusia 40 tahun ini terpaksa ikut pesta bujang liar di Miami demi kariernya.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
original_title: La bataille de Gaulle - partie 2 : J'écris ton nom
overview_en: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.

title: Boulevard
overview_en: Hasley, a girl with a list of unfulfilled dreams, and Luke, a complex and vulnerable boy marked by a tragic past, find refuge on the boulevard where they discover if love can conquer all.

title: Girls Like Girls
tagline: Love begins when you let it in.
overview_en: After her mother's passing, 17-year-old Coley navigates new feelings of intimacy with Sonya in rural Oregon, where both girls must overcome their mutual uncertainties and self-doubt to embrace their connection.

title: Fuze
overview_en: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

title: Agent Zeta
overview_en: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.
overview_id: Empat mantan petugas intelijen Spanyol dibunuh bersamaan di seluruh dunia. CNI menemukan semuanya terlibat dalam "Operasi Ciénaga" puluhan tahun lalu di Kolombia. Zeta, agen terbaik CNI, harus memburu dan melindungi satu-satunya yang selamat, menghadapi misi global paling mematikan. Agen Kolombia terbaik, Alfa, akan bergabung dengan Zeta, yang tampaknya lebih tahu tentang rahasia "Ciénaga".

title: Quantum Supremacy
overview_en: In a future threatened by rogue robots and an all-powerful AI, Captain Monroe and his crew race to prevent humanity's downfall in Quantum Supremacy.

title: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
overview_en: Iroha's life gets knocked off its orbit when Kaguya, a carefree runaway from the Moon, moves in and convinces her to perform in a virtual world together.
overview_id: Kehidupan Iroha kacau saat Kaguya, seorang pelarian yang berjiwa bebas dari Bulan, datang dan tinggal bersama, lalu meyakinkannya tampil di dunia virtual bersama-sama.

title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
overview_en: Two gangsters and the woman they love try to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine.

title: In the Blink of an Eye
original_title: In the Blink of an Eye
tagline: All we share, and all we experience, echoes across time.
overview_en: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life.

title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
original_title: 劇場版モノノ怪 第三章 蛇神
