overview_en: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

title: The Brink of War
tagline: Not all battles are fought with bullets.
overview_en: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

title: Heartstopper Forever
overview_en: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.
overview_id: Tahun sekolah yang baru untuk geng Truham-Higgs datang. Saat hubungan Nick dan Charlie bertambah dalam, pikiran mereka beralih ke kehidupan setelah bel terakhir berbunyi.

title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
overview_en: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.

title: Is God Is
tagline: Make your daddy dead. Real dead.
overview_en: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

title: Do Not Enter
tagline: Getting in is hard, getting out is hell.
overview_en: A group of young explorers investigates an old abandoned hotel, only to encounter a strange supernatural being and a competing group looking for a legendary hidden treasure.

title: Idiots
overview_en: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
tagline: What's that coming over the hill?
overview_en: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

title: Sniper: No Nation
tagline: No flag, no backup, and no mercy.
overview_en: Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a rescue mission in Costa Verde when their friends are taken hostage.

title: Super Troopers 3
overview_en: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 3
overview_en: Tethered by a frightening conclusion, Maya and the Strangers are locked on an unavoidable, unforgiving collision course — a showdown that proves they’re far from strangers now.

title: Power Ballad
tagline: It's time to set the record straight.
overview_en: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about.

title: Iron Lung
tagline: This is not an expedition. It's an execution.
overview_en: In a post-apocalyptic future where an event known as "The Quiet Rapture" caused all known stars and habitable planets in the universe to disappear, a convict is sent to search an ocean of blood discovered on a desolate moon, using a small submarine nicknamed the "Iron Lung".

title: Don't Say Good Luck
overview_en: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.
overview_id: Sebagai pemeran utama, Sophie Birenbaum siap menjadi pusat perhatian dalam drama musikal di sekolahnya—sampai drama di rumah tiba-tiba lebih besar daripada di panggung.

title: The Desert Child
tagline: Lost in the Sahara, raised in the wild.
overview_en: 14-year-old Sun has written and successfully published a story based on an incredible story told by her late grandfather about a wild child called Hadara, who is saved by a group of ostriches when he becomes separated from his family in a storm, and is then raised in the desert amid a host of wild animals, including his best friend, a desert fox. When Sun is invited to travel to the Sahara by a local community who has heard about her book, she meets Kharouba, a Nomad girl of her own age, and realizes there may be much more to Hadara than just a character in a bedtime story.

title: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time
original_title: 劇場版「暗殺教室」みんなの時間
tagline: With ten years' worth of love.
overview_en: United by a common mission to eliminate their teacher, Koro-sensei, an alien creature with phenomenal strength, join Nagisa and his Class 3-E classmates in brand-new adventures.

title: Humint
overview_en: A South Korean agent hunts a drug ring in Russia and goes head-to-head with a North Korean operative — pulling both into peril and tangled secrets.
overview_id: Seorang agen Korea Selatan memburu jaringan narkoba di Rusia dan berhadapan langsung dengan seorang agen Korea Utara — menyeret keduanya ke dalam bahaya dan rahasia yang rumit.

title: One Mile: Chapter Two
overview_en: Former special forces operative Danny is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter Alex, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

title: Bitter Christmas
overview_en: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

title: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-
original_title: ゴールデンカムイ 網走監獄襲撃編
overview_en: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe? The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...

title: The Passenger
tagline: No way out. No way back.
overview_en: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview_en: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

title: The Truthers
overview_en: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

title: Hungry
overview_en: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview_en: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: Bury the Devil
overview_en: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

title: DC
overview_en: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
tagline: Ain’t no one all bad or all good.
overview_en: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

title: Young Washington
tagline: 250 years of history begins with one man.
overview_en: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

title: Animal Farm
tagline: It's time for these animals to stand and fight.
overview_en: A group of farm animals rise up against their neglectful owner, dreaming of equality and freedom. But as the pigs take control, the revolution turns into tyranny, with truth rewritten and dissent crushed.

title: Ikka
tagline: Some trials don't end in court.
overview_en: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

title: Gintama the Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames
original_title: 新劇場版 銀魂 -吉原大炎上-
overview_en: Upon meeting a young boy named Seita who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hinowa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Seita's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea
original_title: 劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件 蒼海の涙編
overview_en: After concluding the opening ceremony of the Demon Kingdom Federation Tempest, Rimuru and his companions are invited by the Celestial Emperor Hermesia of the great elven nation – the Magi Dynasty Salion – to visit her private resort island. As the group enjoys their brief vacation, a mysterious woman named Yura appears. A new incident unfolds against the backdrop of the boundless azure sea.

title: The Last Kiss
overview_en: Laurel always imagined her first kiss would be a fairy tale. Instead, that fantasy turns frightening when she's cursed with an ability to see the death of anyone she kisses. After a vision reveals her crush is doomed to die in a strange murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to unmask the killer before the mystery becomes a massacre.

title: People We Meet on Vacation
tagline: On vacation, you're free to follow your heart.
overview_en: Poppy's a free spirit. Alex loves a plan. After years of summer vacations, these polar-opposite pals wonder if they could be a perfect romantic match.
overview_id: Poppy berjiwa bebas. Alex suka rencana. Karena sering berlibur musim panas bersama, dua teman beda sifat ini menduga mereka bisa jadi pasangan romantis yang sempurna.

title: The Internship
overview_en: A CIA-trained assassin recruits other graduates from her secret childhood program, The Internship, to violently destroy the organization. The CIA fights back with deadly force.

title: Infiltrate
overview_en: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Nightborn
overview_en: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

title: Oscar Shaw
overview_en: After retiring from the police force, a relentless detective haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend sets out on a perilous quest for vengeance, seeking redemption and fighting to restore justice to the streets he once swore to protect.

title: The Magic Faraway Tree
overview_en: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

title: Rise of the Conqueror
tagline: His legacy will be written in fire and blood.
overview_en: In the 14th-century, as the Silk Road crumbles and rival factions tear the land apart, fearless warrior Timur emerges from exile. Stripped of everything, he fights to unite the fractured kingdoms, using strategy and sheer will to carve an empire from chaos. Undefeated in battle and widely regarded as one of history’s greatest military leaders and tacticians, not to mention one of its most brutal, Timur would found the Timurid Empire, which ruled over modern-day Afghanistan, Iran and Central Asia.

title: Joe's College Road Trip
overview_en: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.
overview_id: Demi mengajari cucu laki-lakinya yang manja tentang dunia nyata, kakak Madea yang bermulut kasar, Joe, mengajak remaja yang akan berkuliah ini jalan-jalan lintas negara.

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
overview_en: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"
overview_id: Para pasangan berkumpul kembali dalam pernikahan putri Marcus dan Angela, yang menghadirkan drama lama dan baru saat mereka bertanya, "Mengapa dahulu kita menikah lagi?"

title: Modha Rathri
overview_en: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

title: Barreda
tagline: El Asesino Que Dividió A Un País
overview_en: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Desert Warrior
tagline: One warrior must unite them all.
overview_en: In 7th-century Arabia, Princess Hind becomes a warrior to defy the ruthless Emperor Kisra. Forged into a warrior and aided by legendary bandit Hanzala, Hind unites warring tribes for a last stand—the historic Battle of Dhi Qar—that will change history.

title: Hellfire
tagline: To free the town he'll start a war.
overview_en: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

title: Here the Whole Time
overview_en: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

title: The Christophers
tagline: Art can be copied. Artists cannot.
overview_en: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

title: Jana Nayagan
overview_en: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

title: Hanuman Ansh
tagline: Jinke kaam mein seva, jinke bhav mein bhakti, aur jinke hriday mein Sita Ram.
overview_en: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: Evolution
overview_en: When an alien substance mixes Zoe’s DNA with that of her exotic pets, a hilarious adventure begins where humans turn into animals, animals turn into humans, and everyone must come to an agreement to save the world.

title: A Great Awakening
tagline: Before the American Revolution, there was a revelation.
overview_en: One of the most defining moments in American history is the story of an unlikely friendship between the Reverend George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin.

title: We Bury the Dead
overview_en: After a catastrophic military disaster reanimates the dead, Ava searches for her missing husband amidst an increasingly hostile world.

title: Stop! That! Train!
overview_en: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

title: Killer Whale
overview_en: Follows best friends Maddie and Trish as they find themselves trapped in a remote lagoon with the dangerous killer whale named Ceto.

title: Psycho Killer
overview_en: Following the brutal murder of her husband, a Kansas highway patrol officer sets out on a journey to track down the perpetrator. As the hunt progresses, she comes to realize the man responsible is a sadistic serial killer, and the depth of his mental depravity and his sinister agenda is more twisted than anyone could have imagined.

title: The Isolate Thief
tagline: Underestimating her is a grave mistake.
overview_en: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Rose
overview_en: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

title: Finding Emily
overview_en: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

title: The Bay
overview_en: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
original_title: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
overview_en: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.
overview_id: Chiikawa, Hachiware, dan Usagi memulai petualangan musim panas yang unik ke sebuah pulau misterius yang konon menyembunyikan rahasia putri duyung yang telah lama hilang. Apa yang awalnya hanya liburan menyenangkan dengan cepat berubah menjadi perjalanan yang mengharukan penuh kejutan, menegangkan, dan penuh kekacauan yang menggemaskan. Dengan laut yang berkilauan, legenda aneh, dan pertemuan yang tak terlupakan, Chiikawa belajar tentang keberanian, persahabatan, dan keajaiban yang tersembunyi dalam momen-momen kecil. Rahasia Pulau Putri Duyung akan segera terungkap...

title: Dear You
overview_en: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
tagline: The world depended on them. They depended on each other. A look back after 25 years.
overview_en: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

title: Fjord
overview_en: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
overview_en: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

title: Best of the Best
tagline: It takes two to take over.
overview_en: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
tagline: How many dates does it take to find love?
overview_en: Ready to quit the dating scene altogether, burned-out Leah accepts her grandmother's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights in exchange for a year's rent—only to discover amidst the awkward dinners and unexpected sparks that her biggest obstacle to love is herself.

title: The Moment
tagline: and it's a movie about brat and charli and a tour but none of it happened but maybe some of it did
overview_en: A rising pop sensation navigates fame and industry pressures while preparing for her arena tour debut, revealing the transformation of underground culture into mainstream success.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
original_title: Nando Entre Dois Mundos: Um Filme Sintonia
overview_en: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: Nimrods
overview_en: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: The King's Warden
tagline: 1457 Joseon, a story untold by history.
overview_en: In a remote mountain village of 15th-century Joseon, humble headman Heung-do hears a rumor that any village hosting an exiled nobleman will be blessed with abundance and fortune. Hoping to bring prosperity to his impoverished community, he eagerly submits a petition to host one—unaware that his guest is none other than the fallen monarch, deposed boy-king Danjong.

title: Ikatan Darah
overview_en: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.

title: Gary
overview_en: Two friends go on a work trip and encounter unexpected challenges and local personalities as they navigate their assignment. Their efforts to adapt to unfamiliar surroundings highlight moments of humor, small-town culture and the unpredictable nature of work travel. Their experience offers new perspectives on their friendship.

title: The Swedish Connection
overview_en: Swedish Foreign Ministry bureaucrat Gösta Engzell, overlooked during WWII, rescued thousands while turning supposedly neutral Sweden into a moral force. His efforts challenged the status quo and left a lasting humanitarian legacy.
overview_id: Dalam kisah nyata yang tak terkenal ini, seorang birokrat Swedia tanpa diduga menjadi pahlawan perang saat ia berusaha menyelamatkan nyawa orang Yahudi dalam PDII.

title: Dolly
overview_en: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

title: Blast
overview_en: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview_en: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
tagline: The Story of the Unknown Men Unfolds.
overview_en: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

title: Alpha
overview_en: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

title: ALL YOU NEED IS KILL
overview_en: When a massive alien flower known as "Darol" unexpectedly erupts in a deadly event, unleashing monstrous creatures that decimate the population of Japan, Rita is caught in the destruction—and killed. But then she wakes up again. And again. Caught in an endless time loop, Rita must navigate the trauma and repetition of death until she crosses paths with Keiji, a shy young man trapped in the same cycle. Together, they fight to break free from the loop and find meaning in the chaos around them.

title: Solo Mio
tagline: All roads lead to (being left in) Rome.
overview_en: After Matt's dreams of a picturesque Italian wedding are shattered when his fiancée leaves him at the altar, he embarks on his planned honeymoon across Italy alone, immersing himself in the country's vibrant culture, food, and beauty, meeting Gia along the way.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
original_title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
tagline: It's hammer time... who's your celebrity sex pass?
overview_en: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.

title: One Piece Heroines
overview_en: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

title: I Love Boosters
tagline: Booster: Somebody who steals clothes from a store and sells them at a discount price, aka community service.
overview_en: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

title: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
overview_en: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.

title: Under Your Feet
overview_en: Isabel moves with her two children into a very prestigious building that has a very peculiar admission method but at a very affordable rental fee. Once approved and settled, three elderly neighbors from the lower floor will turn their lives upside down.

title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
overview_en: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?
overview_id: Berlatar belakang masa muda Ip Man sebelum ia menjadi guru besar yang legendaris, film ini mengisahkan perjuangannya dalam menyempurnakan teknik Wing Chun sambil menghadapi tekanan dari sekolah-sekolah bela diri saingan dan ancaman dari pihak asing yang mencoba menguasai wilayahnya. Di tengah konflik fisik dan batin, Ip Man harus membuktikan bahwa kekuatan sejati bukan hanya berasal dari kepalan tangan, melainkan dari keteguhan prinsip dan kerendahan hati.

title: Ghost Elephants
tagline: An epic search for a mythical giant.
overview_en: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

title: Faces of Death
overview_en: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

title: This Is Not a Test
tagline: School's out for the zombie apocalypse.
overview_en: Sloane and four classmates take cover in Cortege High to escape a world plagued by the infected. As danger relentlessly pounds on the doors, Sloane begins to see the world through the eyes of those who actually want to live and takes matters into her own hands.

title: Salvation
overview_en: In a remote village, an exiled clan returns, reviving a decades-old land feud. Seized by divine visions, Mesut challenges his brother’s leadership to save his people. Will this new path bring salvation or tragedy?

title: Chum
tagline: There's no hiding in the sea.
overview_en: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

title: Forbidden Fruits
overview_en: Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of the mall store after hours with fellow fruits Cherry and Fig. When new hire Pumpkin challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

title: The Dresden Sun
overview_en: A brilliant, principled mercenary with a traumatic past works with an insider to steal a valued asset from Peredor Corporation called “the sphere”. The C & Earth corporation, vying for global dominance, seeks to find a solution to an otherworldly technology via a scientist’s project. Meanwhile, a financial analyst, who despises his job at the powerful investment firm Mutual One, finds himself caught between deadly corporate rivals, financial fraud, and technological espionage, and is ultimately forced to run from a psychopathic military contractor.

title: F Valentine's Day
overview_en: Gina hates her Valentine's Day birthday and travels to Greece to prevent her boyfriend's proposal. With help from vacationers Johnny and his sister Mickey, she schemes to delay it – while questioning her relationship.

title: Starbright
overview_en: A young woman becomes the guardian of a fallen star, which she must protect from dangerous forces with the help of a brave stranger.

title: Bad Apples
overview_en: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview_en: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.
overview_id: Semua gelar tenis telah ditaklukkan, termasuk emas Olimpiade. Lalu apa yang masih dikejar? The Wolf in Winter mengikuti legenda tenis, Novak Djokovic, di Australia Terbuka 2025, mengungkap obsesi, persiapan, dan semangat yang tetap membara meski tak ada lagi yang perlu dibuktikan.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
original_title: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich
overview_en: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: Jim Queen and the Quest for Chloroqueer
overview_en: When Heterosis, a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight, sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six-packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

title: The Red Line
original_title: เส้นตาย สายลวง
tagline: When the victim becomes the hunter. When the law fails it's time to reclaim.
overview_en: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money — and their dignity.

title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
original_title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
tagline: An exclusive look inside the HBO series.
overview_en: Featuring interviews from members of the casting, production design, costume design, and creature effects teams, follow the behind-the-scenes journey of bringing the Harry Potter books to the small screen. Find out how the new Golden Trio were found, and celebrate the commitment to detail of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians who have come together to bring the wizarding world to life.
overview_id: Sebuah pandangan eksklusif ke dalam serial HBO Harry Potter, diceritakan oleh para seniman dan kru kreatif yang menghidupkan kembali kisah yang dicintai ini.

title: Husbands in Action
tagline: A chaotic match, a reckless mission.
overview_en: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?
overview_id: Seorang detektif bekerja sama dengan suami baru mantan istrinya untuk mengejar penculik si istri. Bisakah duo unik ini mengabaikan perbedaan demi satu penyelamatan nekat?

title: Grizzly Night
overview_en: On August 12, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: that same night, nine miles apart, there were not one—but two—fatal grizzly bear attacks.

title: Peddi
overview_en: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

title: Balandrau: Where the Fierce Wind Blew
overview_en: On December 30, 2000, a group of friends climbed Balandrau, but an unpredictable blizzard unleashed the worst Pyrenees storm in history.

title: Pavane
tagline: For all who are in love. And who are meant to love.
overview_en: Three lonely strangers meet at their department store jobs and find solace in each other's company while they explore connection and the nature of love.
overview_id: Tiga orang kesepian yang tak saling kenal bertemu ketika bekerja di toserba dan terhibur oleh kehadiran satu sama lain saat mencoba saling terhubung dan menyelami cinta.

title: Je m'appelle Agneta
overview_en: Craving a fresh start, recently unemployed Agneta accepts an au pair gig in Provence that turns into an indulgent escape — and an unexpected awakening.
overview_id: Agneta baru dipecat dan menginginkan hidup baru. Ia menerima pekerjaan sebagai au pair di Provence. Ternyata, ini jadi pelarian menyenangkan dan pencerahan tak terduga.

title: Deviens génial
overview_en: Mathias is a teacher and has finally been transferred to his daughter’s middle school. But no sooner has he arrived than he learns that his German class is being canceled due to a lack of students. He then decides to organize a trip to Germany to motivate the teens to choose the language, and to fund it, he turns to Iris, the head of the local sister city committee. The catch is that Mathias is a Spanish teacher. Between Mathias, who doesn’t speak a word of German, the frustrated teens, and an irrational Iris, the school trip is shaping up to be utter chaos. Yet nothing will stop him from becoming the father his daughter no longer expects… and to achieve his goal, he’ll have to become awesome!

title: Preschool
tagline: Two kids. One spot. Playtime is over.
overview_en: Two determined fathers engage in a comical battle to enroll their kids in an elite preschool, escalating into an absurd competition with unexpected results.

title: Dhamaal 4
overview_en: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

title: Our Hero, Balthazar
overview_en: Eager to impress his activist crush, a wealthy New York teenager follows an online connection to Texas, where he's convinced he can stop an act of extreme violence.

title: Marty, Life Is Short
overview_en: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.
overview_id: Martin Short mengenang kehidupan penuh sukacita dalam dokumenter dengan klip klasik, wawancara baru, dan film-film rumahan bertabur bintang yang belum pernah tayang ini.

title: The Girl in the River
overview_en: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

title: Late Fame
overview_en: At the very end of the 1970s, post office worker Ed Saxberger wrote a book of poetry that nobody cared about. After an eager and flattering fan appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of young admirers who anoint him a rediscovered genius. The group of downtown bohemians is led by their "tragic heroine," Gloria. Intoxicated by the attention, and Gloria's alluring presence, Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle.

title: The Muppet Show
tagline: It's time to raise the curtain.
overview_en: Music, comedy, and a whole lot of chaos is bound to ensue when The Muppets once again take the stage of the original Muppet Theatre with their very special guest, Sabrina Carpenter!

title: I Can Only Imagine 2
overview_en: Following the breakout success of the song 'I Can Only Imagine', MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream—sold-out arenas, a devoted fanbase, and a thriving career. But behind the spotlight, Bart's past threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son Sam. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life through their unlikely friendship. Bart soon discovers that Tim carries hardships—and secrets—of his own, forcing him to face his past and repair his relationships with Sam and his wife Shannon before fame costs him what matters most.
overview_id: Setelah kesuksesan luar biasa lagu 'I Can Only Imagine', Bart Millard dari grup MercyMe kini berada di puncak popularitas—tur yang selalu penuh, basis penggemar yang setia, dan karier yang gemilang. Namun di balik sorotan lampu panggung, masa lalu Bart mengancam keharmonisan keluarga yang ia bangun, terutama hubungan rapuh dengan putranya, Sam. Saat pendatang baru yang penuh semangat, Tim Timmons, bergabung dalam tur terbesar mereka, persahabatan tak terduga di antara keduanya membawa perspektif baru dalam hidup Bart. Namun, Bart segera menyadari bahwa Tim juga menyimpan luka dan rahasia tersendiri. Kini, Bart harus menghadapi masa lalunya dan memperbaiki hubungan dengan Sam serta istrinya, Shannon, sebelum ketenaran merenggut hal terpenting dalam hidupnya.

title: Night Patrol
overview_en: An L.A. cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger.

title: The Marked Woman
overview_en: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.
overview_id: Saat seorang wanita ditemukan di kontainer kargo dan dia hilang ingatan, dua detektif berlomba untuk menemukan identitasnya—dan siapa yang ingin wanita itu mati.

title: The Money Maker
overview_en: A Polish engineer relocates to France and becomes a legendary counterfeiter. Working solo, he crafts flawless fake francs worth millions over 14 years, earning the nickname "Cézanne of counterfeit money" for his artistic skill and output.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview_en: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: Wonderful Nightmare
overview_en: A high-flying, career-driven lawyer dies prematurely due to a clerical error in heaven.

title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express - the Movie
original_title: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ 各駅停車劇場行き
overview_en: Six delinquents are tasked with cleaning a train as part of a community service program. But when the train suddenly takes off, chaos ensues.

title: Ballistic
tagline: A mother's pain, a bullet's purpose.
overview_en: When a soldier's mother discovers the bullet that killed her son in Afghanistan was made at the factory where she works, she sets out on a path of revenge against those responsible.

title: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie
original_title: 劇場版 僕の心のヤバイやつ
overview_en: Kyotaro Ichikawa is a painfully awkward middle school boy deep in the throes of eighth-grader syndrome, spending his days obsessed reading morbid books. His quiet, isolated world is suddenly turned upside down when Anna Yamada, the classroom star, unexpectedly steps into his life. And before he knows it, she is occupying his every day thoughts.

title: Karuppu
overview_en: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

title: Queen of Chess
overview_en: A Hungarian girl dreams of conquering international men’s chess. After a 15-year battle against world champion Garry Kasparov and her domineering father, Judit Polgár revolutionizes the sport’s patriarchal culture to become one of the greatest chess prodigies in history and the greatest woman chess player of all time.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.
overview_id: Ketika insiden tak terduga di jalan membuat putranya berada dalam kondisi kritis, seorang ayah yang marah terjerumus ke dalam jalan gelap penuh gejolak emosi dan dendam.

title: Drishyam 3
overview_en: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

title: Man of War
overview_en: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

title: Euphoria: A Look Back
overview_en: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

title: Savage House
tagline: Polite society has never been so Savage.
overview_en: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

title: Sultana
overview_en: Sultana is a drama set in Istanbul's one and only strip club, telling a story of a women, power, rivalry and solidarity. A new Turkish story where women are not victims in a fairy tale, but warriors learning that the 'handsome prince' is often the real monster- and their only salvation is each other. Meral the long reigning queen of the one and only strip club of Istanbul which is Sultana, takes a talented new Belarusian dancer named Anna under her wing. But she soon realizes she has created a rival powerful enough to replace her, and a ruthless power struggle erupts between the two women.

title: The President's Cake
overview_en: While people across 1990’s Iraq struggle to survive, 9-year-old Lamia has been selected to prepare a cake to celebrate the President’s birthday. In a landscape of fear and scarcity, where basic ingredients are nearly impossible to find, Lamia sets out on a determined journey throughout the big city in search of eggs, flour, and sugar. Accompanied by her grandmother, her loyal friend Saeed, and her pet rooster Hindi, she navigates vendors and police officers along the way.

title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
original_title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
tagline: Billie Eilish and James Cameron reinvent the concert experience.
overview_en: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

title: Couture
overview_en: An American filmmaker faces challenges and self-discovery as she arrives in Paris for Fashion Week on a life-and-death journey.

title: On the Road
overview_en: Veneno, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets Muñeco, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk.

title: Mexico 86
tagline: Not all goals are scored on the field.
overview_en: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.
overview_id: Keberanian, kegilaan, dan kecerdikan ala Meksiko. Meski sulit, Meksiko menjadi tuan rumah turnamen terpenting dalam sepak bola pada 1986. Bagaimana hal ini bisa tercapai?

title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
original_title: 機動戦士ガンダム 閃光のハサウェイ キルケーの魔女
overview_en: Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway Noa is drawn to a mysterious girl named Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for Mafty's mission -- the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Meanwhile, Kenneth Sleg of the Earth Federation Forces prepares a defense operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate Mafty and is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfill her own role.

title: Clika
tagline: There are no shortcuts to living your dreams.
overview_en: Aspiring small-town musician Chito is determined to make it big. When a clip of him performing one of his songs goes viral, he seizes the opportunity and pushes to carve out a place for himself in the new wave of Mexican-American music... and ultimately gets caught in a game more dangerous than anticipated.

title: Carolina Caroline
overview_en: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

title: Maa Inti Bangaram
overview_en: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

title: 7 Dogs
overview_en: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

title: Look Back
tagline: "Keep your eyes on my back and you'll grow too."
overview_en: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
overview_en: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.
overview_id: Di masa keemasan penerbangan, seorang anak pencinta pesawat dan ibunya melakukan perjalanan lintas negara ke Hollywood di mana penerbangan mereka berubah menjadi perjalanan tak terlupakan.

title: LifeHack
overview_en: A thrill-seeking gang of teen hackers must pull off their riskiest heist yet when a woman blackmails them into targeting her crypto-billionaire father.

title: Just an Illusion
overview_en: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
original_title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
overview_en: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.

title: Driver's Ed
tagline: Follow you heart... and the rules of the road.
overview_en: A group of teens hit the road in a stolen driver's ed car, racing against time to help a lovesick high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

title: Satluj
tagline: One man's search for truth exposes thousands of buried secrets.
overview_en: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: The Yeti
overview_en: When an oil tycoon and a famous adventurer vanish into the harsh winter of remote northern Alaska, a hand-picked rescue team endeavors to bring them home. What they don’t know is that they are trespassing on The Yeti’s territory, and the elements are the least of their worries.

title: Kara
tagline: Sometimes, staying dangerous is the only way to stay alive.
overview_en: A thief tries to go straight, but when predatory banks trap his father in debt, he returns to crime — with a determined cop closing in on his trail.

title: Bodycam
overview_en: A call to a quiet suburban home unleashes unthinkable carnage when two officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child, spiraling the tragedy into a fierce, unrelenting fall into the unknown.

title: Rocky's Cat-astrophe
overview_en: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight. While the kitten causes more trouble than expected, Rocky learns that even heroes need help.

title: Torrente for President
overview_en: Years have passed since his last adventure, but José Luis Torrente, the most politically incorrect former cop in Spain, still sees himself as a national hero.

title: Cocorico 2
overview_en: DNA tests before Alice and François's wedding reveal their fathers - an aristocrat and car dealer - aren't as French as they thought.

title: All of a Sudden
tagline: One night. Two strangers. A lifetime of questions.
overview_en: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

title: The Hanged Woman
overview_en: Rosa Martín, a singer-songwriter known as La Ahorcada, takes her own life in the garden of the man she loved, Fran, who treated her as nothing more than a sexual object. The ghost of La Ahorcada remains in Fran's mansion, refusing to be ignored and determined to teach him a lesson. Her obsession will end up turning the lives of Fran and his family into a living hell.

title: Go Team!
tagline: The same f**king team building every year.
overview_en: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

title: Nothing to Lose
overview_en: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

title: Yellow Letters
overview_en: The marriage of Derya and Aziz is under pressure after losing their jobs because of state arbitrariness and moving to Istanbul to live with Aziz's parents. They and their 13-year-old daughter Ezgi have to redefine their way of life.

title: Blue Heron
overview_en: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.

title: Pegasus 3
tagline: Let's lay out the road and race ahead.
overview_en: Bearing the glory of being the 'King of Bayanbulak', Zhang Chi once again embarks on his racing journey, aiming not only to win the race but also to achieve something beyond the competition itself.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview_en: Reluctantly sent to a summer retreat for young cancer survivors, a teenager in remission unexpectedly finds deep connections and new beginnings among fellow campers.

title: Love in Slow Motion
overview_en: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

title: Maternal Instinct
overview_en: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.
overview_id: Polisi memberhentikan wanita yang mengaku baru saja melahirkan. Namun, bayi dan darah itu bukan miliknya. Kebohongan rumit terungkap dalam dokumenter kriminal nyata ini.

title: Skyscraper Live
overview_en: No ropes. No fear. Free solo legend Alex Honnold risks it all in a high-stakes, live ascent of one of the world's tallest skyscrapers in Taipei, Taiwan.
overview_id: Tanpa tali atau takut, legenda pendaki solo tanpa pengaman Alex Honnold menantang bahaya dengan aksi live memanjat salah satu gedung tertinggi di dunia di Taipei, Taiwan.

title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
original_title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
overview_en: Explore the formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the profound influence of original bandmate Hillel Slovak.

title: Irumudi
overview_en: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

title: The Last Scene
overview_en: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

title: No Place to Be Single
original_title: Non è un paese per single
overview_en: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

title: Idhayam Murali
overview_en: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
overview_en: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

title: Midwinter Break
tagline: A day they can't forget. A truth they can't escape.
overview_en: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

title: Kartavya
overview_en: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

title: The Crash
overview_en: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.
overview_id: Remaja ini menabrakkan mobilnya ke gedung hingga pacarnya dan kawannya tewas. Apa yang tampak seperti kecelakaan tragis kini jadi kasus pembunuhan dalam dokumenter ini.

title: Maigret and the Dead Lover
overview_en: Commissioner Maigret rushes to the Quai d’Orsay with Lieutenant Janvier. There, they find Mademoiselle Larrieu in a state of shock. That very morning, she discovered the bullet-riddled body of Mr. Berthier-Lagès, a renowned former ambassador whom she had served as a housekeeper for 46 years. While searching the victim's apartment, Maigret and Janvier uncover hundreds of letters. The diplomat had maintained a fifty-year-long love correspondence with a certain Princess of Vuynes, whose husband - by a strange coincidence - had died just a few days earlier. As he confronts the various members of the two families and the suspicious silence of Mademoiselle Larrieu, Maigret finds himself faced with surprise after surprise, watching his certainties crumble - until the solution to the mystery finally hits him in the face at the very last moment...

title: The Rays and Shadows
overview_en: Jean and Otto, a French newspaperman and a young German Francophile, are fighting for peace in Europe. Jean’s daughter, Corinne, is launching a brilliant acting career in the film world, but war breaks out and France is occupied. The two friends have a major role to play in this new France. Jean becomes a big press baron and an ardent advocate of collaboration with the occupying forces, while Otto becomes the Reich’s ambassador in Paris. Corinne, meanwhile, finds herself thrown into the lion’s pit.

title: The Dreadful
tagline: In a country torn by war, survival comes at all costs… and darkness closes in.
overview_en: In medieval England, Anne and her domineering mother-in-law Morwen struggle to survive on the outskirts of society. But when a man from Anne's past returns from war, a curse begins to take shape through a mysterious knight and threatens to destroy them all.

title: Scare Out
tagline: In the world of spies, no one is ever beyond suspicion.
overview_en: After a critical intelligence leak, a national security unit launches an intensive investigation. But successive setbacks in their arrest operations reveal a shocking truth: the trail leads back to within the unit itself. Amidst a storm of trust and betrayal, a silent battle begins to unfold...

title: A Toxic Love Story
overview_en: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

title: Giant
overview_en: Follows Prince Naseem Hamed from his humble beginnings on the tough working-class streets of Sheffield and his discovery by Ingle, himself a steel industry worker turned boxing trainer. Their unlikely partnership, Naz’s unorthodox style, cocky persona, and sheer dominance in the ring propelled them to the top of boxing’s elite and unprecedented levels of global superstardom, all in the face of the rampant Islamophobia and racism of ’80s and 90’s Britain.

title: Truly Naked
tagline: When porn has become the norm, intimacy is the new taboo.
overview_en: An introverted teen, who has only ever experienced sex through the lens while working for his father’s pornography business, must step out from behind the camera when a feisty classmate challenges him to embrace a real connection.

title: Relationship Goals
overview_en: When TV producer Leah Caldwell aims to become the first woman running New York's top morning show, her ex competes for the same role. Leah stays focused on her career, until chemistry with her ex challenges her priorities.

title: The Giant Falls
overview_en: Follows Boris, a charismatic tour guide who unexpectedly reunites with his estranged father Julián. Their tense and emotional encounters explore past wounds and the possibility of forgiveness.

title: Accused
overview_en: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels. Now under a storm of suspicion and scrutiny, her marriage fractures and the truth blurs. Her wife must decide whether to walk away, or fight for the woman the world is turning against.
overview_id: Hidup seorang dokter kandungan ternama runtuh saat tuduhan serius mengancam karier dan pernikahannya, sementara sang istri berusaha mengungkap kebenaran.

title: Sheep in the Box
overview_en: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

title: Bazaar (Murder in the Building)
overview_en: Misanthropic novelist François writes gripping crime stories – “Agatha Christie meets The Scarlet Pimpernel” – but outside of the swashbuckling imaginary world of his Marquis la Rose-novels, life is far from thrilling. His partner Colette, a professor at the Sorbonne and world-renowned expert on Alfred Hitchcock, is tired of watching François sit around their apartment in his pyjamas and yearns for the excitement of the classic films she watches with her students. When Colette begins to suspect their flamboyant actor neighbour of murdering his wife, the couple’s mundane lives are turned upside down – and their stale relationship is jolted back to life.

title: The Gentleman Thief
overview_en: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

title: Pose
overview_en: Isolated in a grand country manor, a reclusive artist spends a passionate and paranoid weekend with his ex-lover, an obsessive fan, and a potential muse. Hoping to spark a new wave of artistic brilliance over the course of a few tumultuous days, filled with chaos and revelation not all of them will make it out alive.

title: The Dutchman
tagline: Two get on. One gets off.
overview_en: A successful black businessman, haunted by his crumbling marriage and identity crisis, is drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a mysterious white woman he encounters on a New York subway.

title: Mārama
tagline: A Māori gothic story of retribution.
overview_en: 1859. When a young Māori woman is summoned from New Zealand to North Yorkshire, she uncovers her horrific colonial heritage and is compelled to confront and destroy the titled Englishman who devastated her family.

title: Lorne
overview_en: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

title: My Dearest Señorita
overview_en: A young woman from a traditional family learns she's intersex, sparking a journey of self-discovery, gender identity and love found in unexpected places.
overview_id: Seorang wanita dari keluarga kolot mengetahui dirinya adalah interseks. Hal ini memicu perjalanan penemuan jati diri, identitas gender, dan cinta di tempat tak terduga.

title: André Is an Idiot
overview_en: André, a brilliant idiot, is dying because he didn’t get a colonoscopy. His sobering diagnosis, complete irreverence, and insatiable curiosity, send him on an unexpected journey learning how to die happily and ridiculously without losing his sense of humor.

title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
overview_en: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

title: The Legendaries
overview_en: They are brave, intrepid, indomitable, and they turned back to children! While fighting the terrible sorcerer Darkhell, the official heros of Alysia: The Legendaries accidentally broke the Jovenia stone, the one of eternal youth. This is how the whole kingdom of Alysia, and especially our champions, has fallen back into childhood. No more birth, but people keep on dying of accident or sickness… Humanity is then doomed to extinction. A real curse! And quite a blow to the myth of "The Legendaries". The five warriors, formerly admired, have now to lie low… Today blamed and discredited, they are well decided to break the spell and fix their mistake. "Nothing is impossible for a willing heart"… Even at 10!

title: Wasteman
tagline: A bold new vision of life inside.
overview_en: Taylor's hopes for a fresh start post-parole are jeopardised by cellmate Dee's arrival. As Dee takes Taylor under his wing, a vicious attack tests their bond, forcing Taylor to choose between protecting Dee and his own chances at freedom.

title: Bhooth Bangla
overview_en: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there, but strange supernatural events and panicked locals force him to investigate the property's mysterious past.
overview_id: Saat seorang pria mewarisi sebuah istana, ia berencana mengadakan acara pernikahan adiknya di sana—tetapi masa lalu tempat itu yang kelam mengancam mengacaukan perayaan.

title: A Sad and Beautiful World
overview_en: Across three decades of passion, loss, and hope, Nino and Yasmina are bound by a magnetic relationship. Torn between love and survival, they must decide whether to build a family in Lebanon or leave their home despite tragedies.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview_en: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG
overview_en: BTS is back. The iconic group returns to the stage for a live reunion concert to perform legendary hits and unveil brand-new tracks.

title: Dridam
overview_en: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
overview_en: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

title: Night Nurse
overview_en: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Bride of the Year
overview_en: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
original_title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
overview_en: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

title: Checkered Ninja 3
tagline: You can ignore your problems, but you can't escape them
overview_en: In this 3rd installment Alex’s interest for Ninja missions is starting to vanish. He’ll rather spend his time with his friends and Checkered Ninja feels he is overlooked and is eager to engage in a new mission. The result of this is that Alex, by accident, ends up having a conflict with Marco, the bad boy boyfriend of Jessica, entangling him in a conflict he hasn’t asked for and he is pressured by Checkered Ninja to defend himself.

title: Neglected
tagline: How far would you go to save your son?
overview_en: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

title: Call My Agent! The Movie
overview_en: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

title: The Outer Threat
overview_en: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

title: Guru
overview_en: Matt, a charismatic coach, captivates crowds until he spirals into a disturbing downward spiral.

title: The Birthday Party
tagline: Family is the most serious business.
overview_en: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

title: 500 Miles
overview_en: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

title: Reckless
overview_en: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
overview_en: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

title: The Deputy
overview_en: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: The Rajasaab
overview_en: Seeking his lost grandfather, a young man enters a haunted mansion and awakens a family curse powerful enough to upend both his life and reality.

title: Mexicali
tagline: In This Lawless Border Town, One Farmer Becomes the Cartel's Worst Nightmare
overview_en: A former special forces contractor is forced out of retirement as an avocado farmer in Mexico when local gangsters try to force him and his family off their farm.

title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
overview_en: A group of vampires confronts the challenges of adapting to contemporary society while grappling with their own mortality, all while engaged in a conflict with a dangerous enemy.

title: Firebreak
overview_en: Little Lide disappears in the forest while her family packs up their home. As a fire breaks out, her mother must race to reach her before the flames do.
overview_id: Lide kecil hilang di hutan saat keluarganya berkemas untuk meninggalkan rumah. Ketika kebakaran terjadi, ibunya harus cepat menemukannya sebelum api membakar semuanya.

title: Couples Weekend
overview_en: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

title: The American Dream
overview_en: No one would have bet on Jérémy, stuck behind the counter of a video store, or on Bouna, who cleans airports. With no money, no connections, and painfully poor English, who could have predicted they’d one day become big-name agents in the NBA? What they lack in experience, they will make up for in audacity, while remaining true to their one credo, doing business with a human touch. Scouting raw talent while improvising their way up, they’ll fake it until they make it – chasing their American Dream and landing multi-million-dollar deals.

title: Welcome To The Jungle
tagline: Fake film. Real jungle. Real danger. Real idiots!
overview_en: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

title: Wardriver
overview_en: He’s a Wardriver: a hacker who steals from banks, not people—until he’s noticed. Now the money turns violent, and the woman caught in it could save him or kill them both.

title: Misdirection
overview_en: A desperate couple have pulled off a string of high-end break-ins to pay off a mob debt. When they attempt to rob their latest victim, they find themselves caught in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The tables are turned and the hunters become the hunted.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview_en: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: Feel My Voice
overview_en: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.

title: Cold War 1994
overview_en: In 1994, a tycoon's kidnapping shook Hong Kong, threatening its financial standing. Police pursued personal gain while OCID Superintendent Li Wenbin risked everything to navigate conflicting interests and expose the truth.

title: Youth
overview_en: Youth follows Praveen, a 15-year-old boy who enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. As he goes through multiple relationships and heartbreaks, he slowly begins to understand what love truly means. Along the way, the experiences shape his growth, maturity, and outlook on life.

title: Salmokji: Whispering Water
overview_en: An incident unfolds when a film crew goes to a reservoir to update the road view where an unidentified figure was filmed, and they encounter something in the dark, deep waters.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
tagline: Is Raygun a rebel, a villain or an impostor?
overview_en: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: Miss You, Love You
tagline: People have a funny way of growing on you.
overview_en: Forced to plan her late husband's funeral with her estranged gay son's assistant, a blunt, grieving widow forms an unlikely bond with the total stranger as confronting their shared grief surfaces deep family secrets and long-held resentments.

title: Lockbox
overview_en: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled and enigmatic cousin, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

title: A Child of My Own
overview_en: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

title: Tu Yaa Main
overview_en: A wannabe rapper from the outskirts of Mumbai and an affluent influencer elope to a coastal town, only to find themselves trapped in the pool of a derelict resort fighting for survival against the wrath of a ferocious crocodile.

title: 53 Sundays
overview_en: When three siblings agree to meet and discuss their aging father's future, their reunion spirals into bickering, bantering and reliving old grudges.
overview_id: Saat tiga bersaudara setuju untuk bertemu dan membahas masa depan ayah mereka yang menua, reuni mereka berubah jadi pertengkaran, ejekan, dan membangkitkan dendam lama.

title: Mollywood Times
overview_en: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

title: My Best Friend
overview_en: Facing menopause and empty-nest anxiety, friends Julia and Clara decide to travel together to visit their daughters who are on an exchange program abroad.

title: Simpsley
overview_en: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she's tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner's clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
overview_en: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

title: Mardaani 3
overview_en: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.
